semantics.label: Panel navigation label
semantics.description: Used as the compact panel navigation and disclosure title when the Accordion has at least two panels. Leaving it empty disables compact navigation; single-panel Accordions do not show it.

fields.label: Content type
fields.description: Select your type of library for content.

semantics.label: H tags for labels (does not affect the size of the label)
semantics.description: The h tag used on the labels. Normally H2 but if this belongs under an H2 heading use H3. Does not affect the size of the labels, only used for semantical purposes.
